exposure: Duration of second stage of labor (<1 hour, 1-2 hours, >2 hours)
duration of the second stage of labor
Duration of second stage of labor
outcome: Successful vaginal delivery of both twins
Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Women with twin pregnancies who reached the second stage of labor between 2014 and 2020
finding: Prolonged second stage of labor (>2 hours) in twin pregnancies was associated with increased risks of intrapartum cesarean delivery, combined delivery, chorioamnionitis, and neonatal intensive care unit admission.
mod_finding: Prolonged second stage of labor in twin pregnancies was associated with a greater risk of intrapartum cesarean delivery.
